description: This file defines a SwiftUI view named CalculatorView and its associated view model CalculatorCardViewModel, implementing a calculator interface with basic arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide). It manages user input, displays calculation results, and updates the UI accordingly.

classes.name: CalculatorCardViewModel
classes.description: ObservableObject managing calculator logic, including input handling, arithmetic operations, and formatted result string.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the parsed input value to the current result.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts the parsed input value from the current result.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies the current result by the parsed input value.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Divides the current result by the parsed input value, handling division by zero.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets input string and result to initial state.

methods.name: parseInput
methods.description: Converts the input string to a Double, accepting comma or dot as decimal separator.
